description: This Java class defines the LocationTag entity used for categorizing Location objects within the OpenMRS system. It includes properties such as locationTagId, constructors, and methods for getting and setting the ID and name, along with string representation.

classes.name: LocationTag
classes.description: Represents a tag which can be assigned to Location objects for categorization purposes. Inherits from BaseChangeableOpenmrsMetadata to include common metadata fields.
